purpose: Bounded local coat-pattern diagnostic after global descriptors and keypoint controls failed; development only
source: Original MIEWid development archive and verified SAM foreground crops
gallery: Original raw-MIEW diverse10 selection, exactly 60 early references
encoder: Pinned original MIEWid, final backbone feature map before GeM and BN, FP32
foreground: At least 75% non-background pixels in each grid cell; gray127 exact background excluded
centering: One channel mean estimated from selected gallery foreground patches only
matching: Reciprocal nearest patch cosine; at least4 pairs spanning at least2 image quadrants in both images; mean best8 reciprocal similarities, otherwise0
selection: Calibrate similarity/margin on1230-1529 only; report all fixed blends and counts on both development windows
limits: Oracle crops and sparse queries, no tracking claim
Local features have broad receptive fields and may still confuse repeated coat patterns
